title: Attachments
notConfigured: Configure file storage on the server to attach files.
featureError: Could not check file storage. Retry shortly.
readOnly: You cannot change attachments for this task.
failed: The file operation failed. Retry or check its current status.
accessChanged: Your access has changed. Refresh the task.
changed: The upload is still running or its state changed. Refresh and retry shortly.
limit: A task can have at most 5 files, including files being uploaded.
tooLarge: Each file must be 50 MB or smaller.
invalidName: Use a file name without paths or control characters, up to 240 characters.
previewFailed: Could not load the preview. Retry or download the file.
previewUnsupported: This browser cannot display the file. It may use an unsupported format or be damaged. You can download it instead.
